talk.transcript: Today, I will discuss the importance of biodiversity in ecosystems. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in a given area, and it plays a crucial role in maintaining the health of ecosystems. A diverse ecosystem can withstand environmental stress and recover from disturbances more effectively. Additionally, biodiversity contributes to ecosystem services, such as pollination, nutrient cycling, and climate regulation. Protecting biodiversity is essential for our survival and the health of the planet. Therefore, conservation efforts are necessary to preserve the variety of life on Earth.
